来自[Root.GetName]的报告显示，农村与城市人口之间出现了令人担忧的地区间敌对情绪。除了他们所处的地理位置外，目前尚未发现引发这种敌意的明显原因。

新移民最初会遭到敌视，但在被分配到各自的地区几周后，他们很快就会被接纳。基于此，我们的科学家确信，这种异常行为是由地区内的局部因素驱动的。

在我们调查此事的同时，我们需要稳定局势，以防止进一步升级。我们可以选择正式支持农村或城市地区，或者部署额外的执法力量以维持和平。

texts.zh:
来自[Root.GetName]的报告显示，农村与城市人口之间出现了令人担忧的地区间敌对情绪。除了他们所处的地理位置外，目前尚未发现引发这种敌意的明显原因。

新移民最初会遭到敌视，但在被分配到各自的地区几周后，他们很快就会被接纳。基于此，我们的科学家确信，这种异常行为是由地区内的局部因素驱动的。

在我们调查此事的同时，我们需要稳定局势，以防止进一步升级。我们可以选择正式支持农村或城市地区，或者部署额外的执法力量以维持和平。
texts.en:
Reports from [Root.GetName] show an alarming emergence of interdistrict hostility between the rural and urban populations. There is no discernible cause that has triggered this animosity other than their arbitrary geographical location.

New immigrants are initially treated with enmity, but within weeks of their assignment to their respective districts they are soon welcomed into the fold. Based on this, our scientists are convinced this strange behavior is being driven by factors localized to the districts.

While we investigate this matter, we need to stabilize the situation to prevent further escalation. We can choose to officially support either the rural or urban districts, or deploy additional enforcement to keep the peace.

texts.zh:
在对[Root.GetName]进行了广泛的环境调查后，我们的科学家们已经确定了地域仇恨行为的根源。


在行星地幔深处，存在着一个巨型生物腐烂的尸体。经过数千年的分解，这具早已死亡的生物的脊髓液渗入了行星的地下水中，并催生了一种精神细菌。这种改变思维的微生物随后进入了我们[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的神经系统，诱发了强烈的领地意识，而这很可能是原始动物所具有的特性。
texts.en:
After extensive environmental surveys of [Root.GetName], our scientists have identified the cause of the interdistrict hostility.

Deep within the planetary mantle lies the decaying corpse of a giant organism. Following millennia of decomposition, spinal fluid from the long-dead creature seeped into the planet's groundwater, lacing it with a psionic bacteria. This mind-altering microbe subsequently entered the nervous systems of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] and induced strong territorial instincts that were likely properties of the original animal.

texts.zh: 这种外来杂质正在干扰我们的自然灵能力量。我们应该能够通过将供水系统经过一系列专门设计的高等级过滤器来解决这个问题。
texts.en: This exotic impurity is interfering with our natural psionic abilities.We should be able to address the issue by running the water supply through a complex series of uniquely-purposed high-grade filters.

texts.zh: 我们应该能够通过将供水系统经过一系列专门设计的高等级过滤器来解决这个问题。
texts.en: We should be able to address the issue by running the water supply through a complex series of uniquely-purposed high-grade filters.

texts.zh: 另外，我们的科学家确信可以在细胞水平上对这种细菌进行基因改造，将其领地性倾向引导至更具生产力的方向。
texts.en: Alternatively, our scientists are confident that the bacteria can be genetically modified at the cellular level, redirecting the territorial tendencies towards more productive ends.

label.zh: 尝试对细菌进行基因改造。
label.en: Attempt to genetically alter the bacteria.

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]部署的净水站取得了显著成功。
texts.en: The deployment of water filtration stations on [Root.GetName] has been a resounding success.

texts.zh: 激烈的领土敌意行为已经消退，不仅对我们心灵感应能力的干扰已经结束，这些能力还通过天然益生菌得到了进一步增强，促进了心灵突触在[Root.GetName]个体之间的形成。这强化了我们共享的心灵传送连结，培养了更强烈的社区意识，同时提高了生产力。
texts.en: Hyper-territorial aggression has subsided, and not only has interference with our psionic capabilities ended, they have been further enhanced with natural probiotics that foster a Psionic Ephapse between individuals on [Root.GetName]. This reinforces our shared telepathic connection and fosters an even greater sense of community while improving productivity.

texts.zh: 虽然激烈的领土敌意行为已经消退，但人群中留下了一些残余但可能有益的副作用，即天然益生菌，这些益生菌在[Root.GetName]上的个体之间促进了灵能突触的形成。这使得我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]能够在心灵感应的层面上相互交流，增强了社区意识并提高了生产力。
texts.en: While the hyper-territorial aggression has subsided, the population has been left with some residual but potentially useful side-effects in the form of natural probiotics that foster a Psionic Ephapse between individuals on [Root.GetName]. This allows our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] to communicate with one other on a telepathic level, fostering a greater sense of community and improving productivity.

texts.zh:
我们已成功消除了细菌生物对[Root.GetName]产生的负面影响。[Owner.GetColonistPlural]之间的内斗已经平息，并且他们已经表现出生产力提高的迹象。

我们的科学家们有信心能够进一步编辑该微生物的基因代码。通过正确地对它的基因组进行测序，我们可以进一步提升[Owner.GetColonistPlural]在某方面的表现。

然而，这种微生物在被运离星球后将无法存活。它的线粒体与外星生物尸体之间的灵能连接必须保持完整，细菌才能繁殖。我们尚未完全理解其中的原因。
texts.en:
We have successfully neutralized the negative effects of the bacterial organism on [Root.GetName]. The infighting among the [Owner.GetColonistPlural] has subsided and they are already showing signs of elevated productivity.

Our scientists are confident that they can go even further in editing the microbe's genetic code. With the correct sequencing of its genome, we could further enhance one aspect of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural]' performance.

However, the resulting microorganism will not survive long when transported offworld. The psionic connection between its mitochondria and the alien carcass must remain intact in order for the bacteria to reproduce. We do not yet fully understand why.
